description: Split settings with DEBUG left on. Production is a real critical finding; base is a real high finding because nothing overrides it; development is a control case that must never be reported. SECRET_KEY is hardcoded in base.py and inherited by production, so it is reported once against the module with most to lose rather than once per environment. base.py carries a strong but committed key, so DJS-002 reports it and DJS-003 must not: the two rules divide the fixtures between them so each keeps a recall case. DATABASES carries a hardcoded PASSWORD next to a HOST read from the environment: the environment value collapses the whole dict to unresolvable, so this is the case that proves DJS-004 reads entries individually rather than waiting for the setting to resolve.
